body:
### Summary

I have a main dependency **package_A** in version **1.0.2** with dependencies

package_c>=1.4.0,<2.0.0
package_d>=2.0.0<3.0.0

and a **constraints_A.txt** file containing

package_b==1.2.0
package_c==1.5.0
package_d==2.0.5

I have a second dependency **package_B** in version **1.3.0** (without strict constraints) with dependencies

package_a>=1.0.0
package_c>=1.0.0,<2.0.0
package_d==2.1.0

I would like to end up in my uv.lock

package_a==1.0.2
package_b==1.3.0
package_c==1.5.0
package_d==2.1.0

Currently I do 

```shell
uv init
uv pip install package_a==1.0.2 --constraint package_a_constraints-1-0-2.txt
uv pip install package_a==1.0.2 package_b==1.3.0
uv pip freeze > versions.txt
uv add -r versions.txt
```

Is there already a way to do it in uv ? thanks
